boundaries.name: public-name-local-path-and-historical-imports-stay-explicit
boundaries.rule: Public repo references use LEXICON, active product and current contracts use Formarium, the local checkout may still be repos/knowledge-systems/factorium, and frozen Factorium artifacts remain historical imports only. Onboarding, simulation, preview, and portfolio handoff docs must present those four surfaces together before asking a user to edit, validate, or cite this repo.
